about: Written by hand, never by make.py: the deliberate changes to tools of Python's frozen catalog (tools.json) made after it was recorded, each with its decision (ENG-17). part: description (the tool's description text), input_schema (a piece of its input schema as json.dumps writes it, so of every listing's bytes) or validation (the texts its argument checks write). ferb-gateway's catalog applies them to the tool when it loads (rust/crates/ferb-gateway/src/catalog.rs, Change); every test that compares with a recorded text applies them (apply_changes) or takes them out (revert_changes) in the raw and JSON-escaped forms, and a recorded token reserve moves by changes_shift. Old must be in the recorded text once; every other byte is compared as recorded.
